title: Question reads for ineligible action reminders

effect.user: Running actions keep the same reminder policy while skipping questions that cannot affect eligibility.
assertions: Ten unchanged steps preserve actions, linked questions, delivered mail and audit.
Eligible answered commits still read the current answer time, wait thirty minutes and receive one reminder.

idle.why: Empty fleet is a zero-read control.

first-use.why: Fixture boot, dispatch and answer are outside sampled steps.

repeated.why: Ten unchanged DaemonCore steps; three repetitions.

background.why: Running Fix and already-reminded Commit attempts keep polling after an answer.

release.why: No real process is launched; fixture cleanup is tested by ordinary completion.

recovery.why: Existing actions.loop.nudge tests cover reminder persistence, restart and retry; the count fixture itself does not reopen.

fixture.seed: Real temporary SQLite store, FakeDriver and virtual clock; answered fix and answered already-reminded commit actions.

recipe.readiness: Boot, dispatch, question, answer and any first reminder finish before wrappers are installed.
recipe.completion: 24 complete count samples, zero ineligible question reads, unchanged state and eligible reminder boundary control.
recipe.teardown: Close the store and remove the owned fixture in finally, including initial-open failure.

metrics.scope: CoreStore.getQuestion calls during ten DaemonCore steps with running answered Fix or already-reminded Commit actions
metrics.collector: Instance call-through wrapper; fixture setup and parity reads excluded
metrics.invariant: All 24 samples preserve action/question/mail/audit state and make zero ineligible question reads.

gaps: Eligible attempts evaluate the pure policy helper twice and still read questions each tick; aggregate CPU tradeoff is unmeasured.
Other scheduler queries, provider execution, memory and user-visible latency remain unmeasured.
readiness: 24 samples per arm in three paired runs: ten steps at 1/12/120 bees reduce 10/120/1200 discarded question reads to zero; empty remains zero. State checks and eligible reminder boundary control pass.
